title: Warm-up 1: No More Passwords
text: The billing service needs to reach the ledger. There is a database password in a config file, and there is an issuer.
held: No shared secret was involved: billing proved what it was and got a credential that soon expires.

cards.label: Ask the issuer for a short-lived identity
Read the database password from the config file
cards.why: A password in a file is the same secret for everyone who can read the file, forever. It says nothing about who is using it.

cards.label: Issue an identity that lasts one hour
Issue one that never expires, to avoid renewals
cards.why: An identity that never expires is a password with extra steps. Short lifetimes are what limit a theft.

cards.label: Ask for the database password as well
cards.why: Adding a shared password back adds back the thing identities replace. The certificate already says who is calling.
